results.summary: Both pins are already in the right place: the trailhead pin sits on the Sunrise Mine trailhead and the summit pin on Morning Star Peak.
results.evidence: Pin 0 Sunrise Mine Trailhead (48.0247261,-121.4778459): OSM trailhead node 48.0247259,-121.4778590 (~1 m) and five other WA routes pin the same spot; the finding itself says the pin is right and only approach_logistics (48.02389,-121.47414, ~300 m east) differs, which is not a waypoint. Pin 1 Morning Star Peak Summit (48.003885,-121.490955): OSM peak node 48.0038881,-121.4908309 (~10 m). Nothing to move.

results.summary: The trailhead pin is right; the four other pins have no coordinates at all, so there is nothing drawn in a wrong place to move, and the finding was about approach text only.
results.evidence: Pin 0 Downey Creek Trailhead (48.2591,-121.2244): OSM trailhead node 48.2587513,-121.2231016 (~105 m) and a published traverse map marks Downey Creek TH at 48.25879,-121.22310 — within tolerance, leave. Pins 1-4 (Bachelor Flats, Chikamin-Dome Col camp, Dome-Chickamin Col, North Peak Summit) carry no lat/lng, so they are not drawn. Owner note: pins 2 and 3 are the same col listed twice, and their 8,500 ft elevation looks high for that col; with no coordinates on either there was no position to correct and giving them one would need a separately sourced col and North Peak position, so both are left as is.

results.summary: The summit pin sat about 1.7 km west of Rimrock Ridge's high point on lower ground; it now sits on the true summit. The trail and camp pins were already right.
results.evidence: Pin 3 Rimrock Ridge summit was at 48.3721,-121.0001, where the ground is 7,030 ft (USGS) — ~220 ft below the listed 7,254 ft summit and ~1.65 km from it. The USGS place-name record puts Rimrock Ridge at 48.3755664,-120.9782611; the peak database lists the summit (7,254 ft, with lower West and East peaks) at 48.3755,-120.9783. A USGS elevation grid around that point confirms it is the local high point (7,226 ft, all neighbours lower). Moved there; elev 7,230 ft. Pin 1 Fivemile Camp (48.342907,-120.901771) is ~215 m from OSM's Fivemile Camp (48.3443946,-120.9036608) and pin 2 Swamp Creek Camp matches OSM (48.3097092,-120.9204797) to ~10 m — both left. Pin 0 High Bridge trailhead matches the stored trailhead. Owner note: approach_logistics.peakLat/peakLng still hold the old summit coordinate, and the approach text's line east from Swamp Creek Camp remains unsourced, as the finding says.

results.summary: This route never goes to Cascade Pass, so that pin is removed; the river-crossing pin, which sat high on Cascade Peak's flank, now sits on the river beside the last road hairpin; the stored mileages that were measured via the pass are cleared.
results.evidence: Pin 1 Cascade Pass: the route leaves the road at its end, drops to and crosses the Cascade River and climbs the C-J couloir; no ascent to the pass (route page and trip reports; the row's own approach_variants say the same). Removed. Pin 2 Cascade River Crossing / Terminal Moraine was at 48.4655,-121.079, where the ground is 6,250 ft — ~250 m from Cascade Peak's summit (OSM 48.46346,-121.08039), not on any river. Trip reports cross the river straight from the last hairpin before the trailhead; OSM shows that hairpin at 48.47452,-121.07664 with the North Fork Cascade River running beside it (48.47434,-121.07733 / 48.47463,-121.07828). New point 48.4745,-121.0778 on the river ~80 m from the hairpin; ground 3,400 ft (USGS), replacing the stored 4,300. distMi 4.3 / 4.8 / 5.5 on pins 2-4 were all measured via Cascade Pass and no source gives the correct figures, so they are set to null. Pin 3 Base of C-J Couloir sits where the ground is ~5,730 ft (stored 5,200) and no source places the couloir foot precisely, so its position is left. Trailhead (OSM 48.47549,-121.07516) and summit (OSM 48.46485,-121.09206) pins are right.
